label: pjm 35 cc-steam rebaseline
definition: KEEPER. Re-baseline of the pjm_34 recipe (pjm_28 config + forecast-grade reference-price interchange seam + neighbor price-vs-load convexity) on the CC steam-turbine outage coupling now in main: a CC's CT outage derates its full block (CT + the steam it fed) instead of the CT alone, so the steam is no longer phantom-available during CT outages. Nothing tuned to PJM's net-MWh/price residual. Coal-tot over: 2023 +15.7% (was pjm_34 +18.7%), 2024 +5.0% (+3.9%), 2025 +8.7% (+7.5%); gas in tolerance all years (+1.4/+3.6/+3.0%). FINDING: the bituminous 0.76 passthrough floor is NOT the coal-over lever — 2025 has zero retirees yet COAL_BIT overs +7.8% at a ~1.08 passthrough (near full fuel cost, $3.52 gas ~ gas_mid 3.40), and the over runs INVERSE to the cheap-gas discount (2024 deepest discount 0.79 -> smallest over). Residual coal-over is structural (operable-coal baseload + 2023/24 retiree over-dispatch: Homer City/Sammis/Warrior Run 6.25 TWh in 2023, 3.2 in 2024, 0 in 2025), addressable only by measured COD fractional-retirement + CAMPD unit availability, not by tuning the passthrough.
